location_description: Country Club is a census-designated place and a suburban unincorporated community located in northwest Miami-Dade County, Florida, United States.  It is named after the Country Club of Miami, which was established in 1961 in what was then an unpopulated and undeveloped section of the county. The population was 36,310 at the 2000 census.
